name: MCP SQL Server
description: Enables interaction with Microsoft SQL Server databases using both SQL Server and Windows Authentication. It supports flexible connection configurations, including read-only modes and encrypted communication for secure data management.

rawRecord.description: Enables interaction with Microsoft SQL Server databases using both SQL Server and Windows Authentication. It supports flexible connection configurations, including read-only modes and encrypted communication for secure data management.

DOMAIN.description: The Windows domain (optional, used when USE_WINDOWS_AUTH is true).

PASSWORD.description: The password for SQL Server authentication or specific Windows user.

READONLY.description: Whether to connect in read-only mode ('true' or 'false').

USERNAME.description: The username for SQL Server authentication or specific Windows user.

SERVER_NAME.description: The SQL Server instance name or IP address (e.g., localhost, localhost\SQLEXPRESS, or 192.168.1.100,1433).

DATABASE_NAME.description: The name of the database to connect to.

USE_WINDOWS_AUTH.description: Whether to use Windows Authentication ('true') or SQL Server Authentication ('false'). Defaults to 'false'.

TRUST_SERVER_CERTIFICATE.description: Whether to trust the server certificate ('true' or 'false').

rawRecord.name: MCP SQL Server
